servinfo.title: Road Test
servinfo.ptxt: This test is to check if upshift, downshift and lock-up take place at specified speeds while actually driving vehicle on a level road.

attention1.ptxt: If you do not select a suitable route and take proper precautions when performing a road test, an accident can occur.

item.ptxt: Select a level road with no traffic to minimize the risk of accident.
Perform the road test with 2 persons, a driver and a tester.

attention3.ptxt: Limit the driving speed permissible in road conditions and regulations.

s1.ptxt: With engine running at idle, shift select lever to D range.
While driving in D range, check if gear shift and lock-up take place properly as shown in Automatic Gear Shift Table .

servinfosub.title: Automatic Gear Shift Table
servinfosub.ptxt: Automatic gear shift schedule is shown in the following table. Test-drive the vehicle on a level road.

attention3.ptxt: The gear change is done at the shift point different from the above while any of the following control function is working. Bear this in mind when performing inspection.

item.ptxt: Cruise Shift Control is executed by selecting appropriate gear according to requirement for retaining a constant vehicle speed or acceleration to reduce frequent up-shift and down-shift operations while cruising.

condition.ptxt: Unable to run in D range

action.ptxt: Substitute a known-good TCM and recheck DTC.
Replace torque converter referring to A/T Assembly Reassembly .
Repair or replace oil seal, O-ring and sealant referring to A/T Assembly Reassembly .
